protocol.purpose: Distinct public-input comparison-coverage hypothesis after the closed route-preservation failure. Preserve original proposal and compare omitted movement rather than vetoing walls.
protocol.policy: Only candidate-team Nightmare roots with the immutable original ground-wall proposal. Preserve the complete original-v1 retained set and order. If it has no pure move, append exactly one existing legal catalog move with the highest finite already-computed native leaf score; stable ties use catalog order. If a pure move already survived, leaf evidence is missing/misaligned, or no finite own pure move exists, keep original v1 unchanged. No new paths, outcome-derived threshold, RNG draw, forecast masking, forced action or change to native material/neural selection.
protocol.controls: Default has adopted locked V3/contextual draft, ranked setup, accepted A19 neural pair, H64/complementary R2/K6 and adopted melee-barrel correction. V1 is the exact prior immutable wall proposal. Observation only computes both proposals without adding them.
protocol.population: 216 fresh legal Nightmare-preference draft families. First four Nightmare rosters per map/own-doctrine/opponent-doctrine/pick-order stratum from 96 fixed attempts per map/doctrine pair. Conditional population; not global default draft frequency.
protocol.preflight: Four separate already-opened canary executions; zero fresh games. Not strength evidence.
protocol.admission: First previous observer case with omitted movement per map/own-doctrine/seat (18), plus first six cases with no omission. Outcome-independent coverage selection. Both off/v1 must replay exact old traces on current frozen source; all off/observer and same-host cold repeats exact.
protocol.admissionGate: All quality checks plus at least three actually added movement comparisons across two maps and at least one selected appended move. Fail closed without fresh games otherwise.
protocol.scoring: Win1 draw0.5 loss0. Four paired differences averaged within each family; all216 families equally weighted.
protocol.diagnosticContrast: v1-off, not a retrospectively promoted candidate
protocol.interval: 20,000 whole-family bootstrap draws, Python Random73117720; simultaneous95% Bonferroni endpoints1.25%/98.75% for two primary contrasts; ordinary95% for v1-off diagnostic. Independent raw-outcome/integer-family and exact empirical convolution verification, same frozen quantile-tolerance bands as prior corrected study.
developmentGates: at least10 changed trajectories versus original v1 across2 maps
at least3 selected appended moves across2 maps
positive estimate and positive simultaneous95% lower bound for both primary contrasts
nonnegative each own-doctrine mean for both primary contrasts
protocol.effectThreshold: No additional half-point minimum; user values small gains. Failed earlier gates remain unchanged.
protocol.promotion: No automatic serving activation. Development pass permits a separately registered fresh confirmation and serial serving-cost validation within+10%. No candidate replacement after fresh opens. Failure closes this candidate and bank.
protocol.hostAllocation: First two of four families per map/own-doctrine/opponent-doctrine/pick-order stratum local, last two Puffalo. All arms and repeats of each family stay on one host. Fresh cold repeats cover both hosts, every map/own-doctrine combination and both seats:72 executions per host. Admission cold12 per host.

reservationFormula: SHA256(namespace:counter) first4bytes little-endian, counters1..20480. Every scanned seed reserves n+i and permuteRankedDraftSeed(n+i), i0..31, including rejected and unused scans.

coverageDiagnostic.scope: Coverage-only audit of every previous completed observer root. Admission chosen by first missing-movement case for each map/own-doctrine/seat, plus first six no-missing-movement cases; no outcomes used.
